description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {R}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Slimefoot and Squee to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Body Launderer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.
